reading.body:
This record represents a data center attributed to Aureon in Des Moines, Iowa, but the underlying facts do not support that attribution. Aureon's published web presence describes the company as a wholesale network connectivity and managed services provider with 60,000 miles of fiber, listing only corporate office addresses in West Des Moines and Overland Park, Kansas. No data center facility address, power capacity, square footage, or other operational specifications appear on the operator's own site.

The coordinates stored for this row reverse-geocoded to a single downtown Des Moines address with no independent corroboration. Without a second source confirming an Aureon data center at that location, and absent any published specifications from Aureon itself, this facility cannot be read as a meaningful asset in the AI infrastructure inventory. The operator attribution may require future review.

Iowa has 52 mapped facilities but only two with published power figures totaling 18 MW. This record ranks third by published megawatts in the state, a position that reflects the absence of real specifications rather than the presence of capacity. For a reader assessing where AI compute is actually scaling, this entry contributes no verified information.
